cardOverview.overviewText: A co-branded IRCTC card from HDFC providing accelerated rewards on train ticket bookings, surcharge waivers, and benefits for frequent rail travelers.

items.child: 5% cashback on booking IRCTC train tickets.

benefitRows.name: SmartBuy
benefitRows.description: 5% cashback on booking IRCTC train tickets.
benefitRows.offer: This card provides an additional 5% cashback on booking IRCTC train tickets using HDFC Bank SmartBuy.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this benefit, book your train tickets on the IRCTC website or app. Pay using your HDFC IRCTC credit card through the HDFC SmartBuy portal to receive an additional 5% cashback on your bookings. For queries, contact HDFC customer care at 1800 267 4333.
